question_text: Construct contains_sorted(target, values) in Python for an ascending list of integers. It must return True exactly when target occurs. Use iterative binary search; do not use in, index, bisect or a linear scan.
adaptation_rationale: Iterative binary-search construction retained; explicit restrictions assess the search algorithm rather than a library lookup.

marking_points.criterion: Compares middle item with target and returns True on equality.
Moves low to middle+1 or high to middle-1 as appropriate.
Returns False after interval becomes empty.
